'''Ken-Kiba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]] member of a [[Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang|spice runner gang]] operating on [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He had frequent clashes with [[Musori's gang]], so he and [[Ember Chankeli]] developed a plan to deal with [[Slavery/Legends|enslavers]] by hiring an [[Dass Jennir|outsider]] to deal with them.
